Country code KW. No subdivisions in vacanza (single national list). Suffixes for estimated/observed dates lifted into separate boolean flags (is_estimated=1093, is_observed=0). Name collisions on the same date concatenated with '; ' (vacanza native behavior). Native Arabic preserved via ensure_ascii=False.
